venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Thu 9/10 (MOD Jk, entered by Mya).** Net $1,426 vs $2,126 target; food $308; comps $15.60; 42 guests / $33.96 avg. First football Thursday officially in the books — much livelier start than Wednesday, lots of familiar faces; opener out ~8pm. No table tents yet, so staff informing guests of weekly and Thursday football specials by word of mouth; POS buttons still being perfected. Barback handled weekend prep. Kitchen: keep pushing snack quality/presentation. 86 plastic cups. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: a guest came in because of the football specials posted on Instagram.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Hot but tolerable; heavy foot traffic from last River Steps Concert
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Thu 9/10 (MOD KK/KE/MD, Chef JMS; entered by JO).** Net $5,738 vs $3,100 target (185%); food $518; comps $38.60 (0.7%: industry, Neuhoff resident, DNL, employee, F&F); ~259 guests / $22.15 avg. Fine start inside (~$800); outside started strong but was cut short by a last-minute switch-up from the Neuhoff event — never saw the usual inside pop during a River Steps Concert. Adapted with staff cuts. Kitchen: solid food sales, decent TNF specials; JMS present inside and out. Maintenance: Well 1 soda tap handle cosmetically broken. No incidents. Favorite moment: Remy/Cointreau leaders (TJ and crew) visited after a company outing and tried bingo specials; Daisy and Alexis from Fishmonger stopped in post-shift.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Thu 9/10 (AM Graham/Chef Josh & Lucas; PM Evan/Chef Rachel).** Total net incl. events $9,992.84 vs $11,638 target (86%); DC/AM $1,098.47, D&C PM $7,197.96, Garden/6A $1,610.92; food $1,921; no events; comps $310 (~3.1%); 203 guests (Tock) / ~$49.23 avg. AM: chill pace, lots of cocktail reps (mostly espresso martinis). PM: quiet in both Garden and Lobby, small pop around 10 that petered out; smooth service. Garden: another chill night. Kitchen: chill shift, burner covers and two trays cleaned, rest tomorrow. Break make-up complete; no incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moments: Graham as floor opener ('Grahamager'); dropping a Patatas Bravas IRD in a guest's room.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Thu 9/10 (MOD Kyler, Chef Steves; entered by Stef).** Total EOD net $5,948 vs $5,367 target (111%); food $595; beverage $5,353; comps $130.52 (2.2%, lots of DNL); 177 guests / $34 avg. Slower start and finish with flat seatings mid-evening; lively groups more into each other than the cocktails; lots of corporate groups. Top sellers: Rosalie, Burner Phone, Eight Limb and High Plains (tied). Kitchen: Will's first training day. Door: slow start, then a crowd gathered at 8:15 sharp and filled the room, short waitlist (two groups ~30 min), full through most of the night, quieted at midnight. Industry: Charlie Jade Paul (PDT), Benjamin Brown (Lions Pub); investor Thomas Smyth. 3 birthdays. No no-shows. Menu 18/18; DOF chipped.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Thu 9/10 (MOD Julian, Chef Saleh).** Net $5,160 vs $1,080 target (target as typed; likely mis-entered); food $973; all Marquee (standing room $0); comps $205.94 (handful of DNLs, couple of gifts); 125 guests. Form typed check avg '$96.00' which doesn't reconcile with net/guests — recorded as $41.28 (net ÷ guests). Steady night, picked up ~9pm and held to ~11. Several birthday celebrations including staffer Bailey (red velvet cake). Celebrity visit: Donnell Rawlings (Chappelle's Show) loved the drinks and the cheese-plate brittle. Another successful training day for Gracy; lots of positive first-time-guest feedback. Kitchen: Saleh solo. 86 micro shiso, pot de crème, yellow Chartreuse, kirschwasser cherry; low Don Fulano blanco/repo. No incidents; no-shows charged. Favorite moment: Bailey's birthday.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.weather: Hot to start, lovely after sundown
venues.narrative: **DC — Thu 9/10 (MOD Marcus).** Total net incl. events $3,692.71 vs $4,272 target (86%); Marquee bar sales $4,062.01; Garden $0; food $487; comps $63.20 (DNL $41, F&F $7.20, gift $15); 89 guests (72 walk-in / 17 reso) / $40.58 avg. Handful of tables at open, little traction until ~6:30, light until a solid pop at 9:15 that carried to ~11:30, trickle after; last call 12:30. Cut server Tyler at 8 and host Devan at 8:30. Charles staged as barback and showed promise, helping Rasaan on dishes. Jesse worked expo/touched tables; Ben and Sophia assisted. Kitchen: lighter night, time to ABK. Do better: work to completion when slow — don't leave tables/seats unbussed. Maintenance: curtain rail. No incidents; no-shows charged. Favorite moment: guests from yesterday's event returning at open.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Thu 9/10 (AM Sam & Lex; PM Justin & Shannon; entered by Alexis).** Total net $7,503 vs $6,468 target (116%); Municipal Bar AM $825 / PM $5,416; Sun Club $0 (closed); Hot Eye $1,262; food $3,003; comps $80; guests 26 AM + 107 PM = 133 (OpenTable) / ~$56.41 avg. Morning very chill — only 4 guests before 11am, two small food-tour groups, no IRD. Evening: nice pace, three servers early for walk-ins then cut to two by 8pm; walk-in 9-top and several large patio parties; late pop of drinkers after 10pm. Hot Eye: dead first 3 hours, then large parties filled the booths by 10 and near-full house to midnight; multiple birthdays, industry crew from Hawthorn, C&L and Common, returning SCAD kids. Kitchen: 86 romanesco. No incidents. Favorite moment: friends Bobby & Warren ringing in their birthday.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Thu 9/10 (MOD Julian Abel).** (Form date typed 2026-09-11 / Thursday; matched to 9/10 by post time and day-of-week.) Net $11,807 vs $10,000 target (118%); food $1,383; comps $394 (many guests unhappy about the food situation; a lot of industry in) plus shifties $164; 240 guests / $49.20 avg. Solid night — team stayed united through a late push; great vibes. Kitchen killed it; cheese boards available starting tomorrow; note Thu–Sat full kitchen offerings until 11pm (small miscommunication on offering times). Maintenance: upstairs CO2 regulator malfunctioning, moved to prep for diagnosis. 86 CLM, cookies, crab salad. No incidents; no-shows not charged.
